author: arabalika
description:
US rent history
	

Daily snapshots of US rental listings, down to individual units. One partition per
day (date=YYYY-MM-DD); rows carry observed_date.

	
		
table
one row per
main columns


		
property_obs
listing × day
key, name, address, city, state, zip, lat, lng, property_type, total_units, units_available, price_min/price_max, deals_json, fees_json, is_unpaid


floorplan_obs
floor plan × day
key, floorplan_id, bed_count, bath_count, sqft_min/sqft_max… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/arabalika/us-rent-history.
